title: Lead Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Larch is a startup building travel apps. We are looking for a lead-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Fennick office.

Our stack: kotlin, swift. You will ship features end to end, improve app performance and stability and work closely with design and product.

Four-day weeks in summer. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
